description: Windows endpoint security sensor for real-time kernel telemetry, threat detection, memory scanning, and forensics.
pre_install: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Fibratus MSI not found: $msi" }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "Fibratus installation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }

pre_uninstall: if (!(is_admin)) { error "$app requires administrator rights to $cmd"; break }

script: if (!(Test-Path -LiteralPath $msi -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Fibratus MSI not found: $msi. Refusing to remove Scoop files while Windows Installer registration may remain." }
if ($process.ExitCode -notin @(0, 3010)) { throw "Fibratus uninstallation failed with exit code $($process.ExitCode). Log: $log" }
if ($null -ne $service) { throw 'Fibratus Windows service is still registered after uninstallation.' }

notes: Nonportable by design. Requires an elevated Scoop session. The official MSI installs the Fibratus Windows service under the protected %ProgramFiles%\Fibratus\Bin directory, runs it as LocalSystem with automatic startup, and adds that Bin directory to the machine-wide PATH. No Scoop shim is needed; reopen terminals after installation to pick up the PATH change. Do not redirect the service executable into the user-writable Scoop directory.
